Title: Avocado Toast
How_To_Cook: "1. Preheat toaster to medium (2-3 min). 2. Toast bread until golden. 3. Mash avocado with a pinch of salt. 4. Spread avocado on toast. 5. Drizzle olive oil on top and serve."

Title: Greek Yogurt Parfait
How_To_Cook: "1. Chill glass for 5 min. 2. Spoon Greek yogurt into glass. 3. Layer berries on top. 4. Repeat layers if desired. 5. Drizzle honey and chill for 5 min."

Title: Oatmeal with Banana
How_To_Cook: "1. Bring almond milk to simmer (3-4 min). 2. Add oats and cook 5 min. 3. Slice banana into rounds. 4. Mix banana into cooked oats. 5. Serve warm with a drizzle of honey."

Title: Chickpea Salad
How_To_Cook: "1. Drain and rinse chickpeas. 2. Dice cucumber and tomato. 3. Combine chickpeas and vegetables. 4. Add olive oil and lemon juice, toss gently. 5. Chill 5 min before serving."

Title: Lentil Soup
How_To_Cook: "1. Rinse lentils under cold water. 2. Dice carrot and onion. 3. Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil over medium heat 3-4 min. 4. Add lentils, carrots, and broth; bring to boil. 5. Reduce heat, simmer 25-30 min until tender."

Title: Grilled Chicken Bowl
How_To_Cook: "1. Preheat grill to medium-high (~375°F). 2. Season chicken with salt and pepper. 3. Grill chicken 6-7 min per side until internal temp 165°F. 4. Cook rice according to package instructions (~12 min). 5. Steam broccoli 5 min and assemble bowl."

Title: Tofu Stir Fry
How_To_Cook: "1. Press tofu 10 min to remove water. 2. Slice bell peppers. 3. Heat oil medium-high 2 min. 4. Add tofu and peppers, stir fry 5-6 min. 5. Add soy sauce and ginger, cook 1 min, serve."

Title: Quinoa Veggie Bowl
How_To_Cook: "1. Rinse quinoa. 2. Boil in water medium heat 12-15 min. 3. Sauté zucchini and spinach 5 min in olive oil. 4. Mix cooked quinoa and vegetables together. 5. Season with salt and pepper, serve."

Title: Egg Scramble
How_To_Cook: "1. Beat eggs with pinch of salt. 2. Heat oil medium 1-2 min. 3. Add eggs and scramble 2-3 min. 4. Add spinach, cook 1-2 min until wilted. 5. Serve immediately."

Title: Baked Salmon
How_To_Cook: "1. Preheat oven 375°F (190°C). 2. Place salmon on baking sheet. 3. Drizzle olive oil and lemon slices. 4. Bake 15-20 min until cooked. 5. Let rest 2 min and serve."

Title: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
How_To_Cook: "1. Boil spaghetti 8-10 min until al dente. 2. Slice garlic thin. 3. Heat olive oil medium, sauté garlic 2-3 min. 4. Toss pasta with garlic oil. 5. Garnish with parsley and serve."

Title: Chicken Tacos
How_To_Cook: "1. Season chicken with spices. 2. Cook chicken medium-high 6-7 min per side. 3. Warm tortillas 1 min each. 4. Assemble tacos with chicken, lettuce, cheese, salsa. 5. Serve immediately."

Title: Paneer Butter Masala
How_To_Cook: "1. Dice paneer. 2. Sauté onion in butter medium 3-4 min. 3. Add tomato cream, simmer 5 min. 4. Add paneer, garam masala, cook 5 min. 5. Serve with steamed rice."

Title: Sushi Rolls
How_To_Cook: "1. Cook sushi rice 12 min. 2. Slice cucumber thin. 3. Lay nori on bamboo mat. 4. Spread rice, add cucumber. 5. Roll tightly, brush sesame oil, slice, serve."

Title: Shakshuka
How_To_Cook: "1. Heat olive oil medium 2 min. 2. Sauté onion 3 min. 3. Add tomato and spices, simmer 5-6 min. 4. Make wells, crack eggs, cover 5 min. 5. Serve hot with bread."

Title: Falafel Wrap
How_To_Cook: "1. Heat oil medium-high 2 min. 2. Warm tortilla 1 min. 3. Place falafel on tortilla. 4. Add lettuce, tomato, tahini. 5. Roll and serve."

Title: Beef Stir Fry
How_To_Cook: "1. Heat oil medium-high 2 min. 2. Add beef 5 min. 3. Stir fry broccoli 4 min. 4. Add soy sauce, garlic, ginger 2 min. 5. Serve hot with rice."

Title: Miso Soup
How_To_Cook: "1. Boil water 5 min. 2. Dissolve miso paste. 3. Cube tofu, add to pot. 4. Add seaweed, cook 2 min. 5. Garnish with green onion, serve."

Title: Caprese Salad
How_To_Cook: "1. Slice tomato and mozzarella. 2. Layer alternating slices. 3. Sprinkle basil. 4. Drizzle olive oil and balsamic. 5. Serve chilled."

Title: Pad Thai
How_To_Cook: "1. Soak noodles 10 min. 2. Heat oil medium 2 min. 3. Stir fry shrimp 3 min. 4. Add noodles, egg, sauce, cook 5 min. 5. Garnish with peanuts and serve."

Title: Vegan Buddha Bowl with Tahini
How_To_Cook: "1. Cook quinoa 12 min. 2. Roast chickpeas 15 min at 375°F. 3. Sauté spinach 3-4 min in olive oil. 4. Assemble bowl with quinoa, chickpeas, spinach. 5. Drizzle tahini dressing and serve."

Title: Sweet Potato and Black Bean Chili
How_To_Cook: "1. Dice sweet potato. 2. Sauté onion medium 3-4 min. 3. Add sweet potato, beans, tomato, chili powder. 4. Simmer 20 min. 5. Serve hot."

Title: Vegan Mushroom Risotto
How_To_Cook: "1. Sauté onion 3 min. 2. Add mushrooms 5 min. 3. Add rice, toast 2-3 min. 4. Gradually add broth, stirring 15 min. 5. Finish with olive oil, serve."

Title: Chicken Fajitas
How_To_Cook: "1. Slice chicken, peppers, onion. 2. Heat pan medium 2 min. 3. Cook chicken 5-6 min. 4. Add peppers, onions, cook 4 min. 5. Assemble tortillas with mixture, serve."

Title: Vegan Thai Curry
Ingredients: tofu;broccoli;red bell pepper;coconut milk;red curry paste
How_To_Cook: "1. Heat coconut milk 2 min. 2. Add red curry paste, stir. 3. Add tofu and vegetables, simmer 10 min. 4. Stir occasionally. 5. Serve with rice."

Title: Grilled Vegetable Panini
How_To_Cook: "1. Preheat panini press 2 min. 2. Slice vegetables thin. 3. Layer veggies and cheese on bread. 4. Drizzle olive oil. 5. Grill 5 min until golden."

Title: Vegan Stuffed Peppers
How_To_Cook: "1. Preheat oven 375°F. 2. Cook quinoa 12 min. 3. Mix quinoa, beans, tomato, cumin. 4. Stuff peppers with mixture. 5. Bake 20 min, serve."

Title: Beef and Broccoli Stir Fry
How_To_Cook: "1. Slice beef thin. 2. Heat oil medium 2 min. 3. Add beef, cook 5 min. 4. Add broccoli, garlic, ginger, cook 4 min. 5. Serve hot with rice."

Title: Vegan Mediterranean Quinoa Salad
How_To_Cook: "1. Cook quinoa 12 min. 2. Dice cucumber, tomato. 3. Mix vegetables with quinoa. 4. Drizzle olive oil, lemon juice. 5. Chill 5 min, serve."

Title: Shrimp Tacos
How_To_Cook: "1. Heat oil medium 2 min. 2. Cook shrimp 3-4 min. 3. Dice lettuce, tomato. 4. Warm tortillas 1 min. 5. Assemble tacos with shrimp, vegetables, salsa, serve."

Title: Vegan Curry Noodles
How_To_Cook: "1. Soak noodles 10 min. 2. Heat oil medium 2 min. 3. Add tofu, cook 3-4 min. 4. Add broccoli, coconut milk, curry powder, simmer 5 min. 5. Serve hot."

Title: Chicken Teriyaki Bowl
How_To_Cook: "1. Cook rice 12 min. 2. Grill chicken 6-7 min per side. 3. Steam broccoli 5 min. 4. Pour teriyaki sauce over chicken and broccoli. 5. Sprinkle sesame seeds, serve."

Title: Vegan Lentil Soup
How_To_Cook: "1. Dice vegetables. 2. Sauté onion, garlic medium 3 min. 3. Add lentils, carrot, celery, 3 cups water. 4. Simmer 20 min. 5. Serve hot."

Title: Grilled Veggie Skewers
How_To_Cook: "1. Preheat grill 375°F. 2. Skewer vegetables. 3. Brush with olive oil and herbs. 4. Grill 10-12 min, turning occasionally. 5. Serve hot."

Title: Vegan Black Bean Burger
How_To_Cook: "1. Mash black beans. 2. Mix oats, onion, garlic, spices. 3. Form patties. 4. Cook medium 5-6 min per side. 5. Serve on bun with toppings."

Title: Baked Tofu with Veggies
How_To_Cook: "1. Preheat oven 375°F. 2. Cube tofu. 3. Toss tofu and veggies with oil, soy sauce. 4. Bake 20 min, stirring halfway. 5. Serve hot."

Title: Vegan Stuffed Zucchini
How_To_Cook: "1. Preheat oven 375°F. 2. Hollow zucchini. 3. Mix quinoa, tomato, olive oil, garlic. 4. Stuff zucchini with mixture. 5. Bake 20 min, serve."

Title: Vegan Mediterranean Wrap
How_To_Cook: "1. Spread hummus on tortilla. 2. Slice cucumber, tomato, lettuce. 3. Layer vegetables on tortilla. 4. Roll tightly. 5. Serve immediately."

Title: Chicken Pesto Pasta
How_To_Cook: "1. Cook pasta 8-10 min. 2. Grill chicken 6 min per side. 3. Toss pasta with pesto, chicken, parmesan. 4. Drizzle olive oil. 5. Serve hot."

Title: Vegan Chickpea Stew
How_To_Cook: "1. Dice vegetables. 2. Sauté carrot and potato 3-4 min. 3. Add chickpeas, tomato paste, spices. 4. Simmer 20 min. 5. Serve hot with bread."

Title: Spaghetti Bolognese
How_To_Cook: "1. Boil spaghetti 8-10 min. 2. Sauté onion in olive oil 3 min. 3. Add ground beef, cook 5-6 min. 4. Stir in tomato sauce, simmer 10 min. 5. Serve over spaghetti."

Title: Chicken Alfredo Pasta
How_To_Cook: "1. Cook pasta 8-10 min. 2. Grill chicken 6-7 min. 3. Heat cream and butter medium 2 min. 4. Mix pasta, chicken, sauce. 5. Sprinkle parmesan and serve."

Title: Cheeseburger
How_To_Cook: "1. Shape beef patty. 2. Grill 5-6 min per side. 3. Toast bun 1-2 min. 4. Add cheese on patty 1 min before done. 5. Assemble with lettuce, tomato, serve."

Title: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
How_To_Cook: "1. Butter bread slices. 2. Heat skillet medium 2 min. 3. Add cheese between bread. 4. Cook 3-4 min per side. 5. Add tomato or ham if desired, serve."

Title: Chicken Stir Fry
How_To_Cook: "1. Slice chicken thin. 2. Heat oil medium 2 min. 3. Stir fry chicken 5 min. 4. Add vegetables, garlic, cook 4 min. 5. Add soy sauce, stir 1 min, serve."

Title: Pancakes with Syrup
How_To_Cook: "1. Mix flour, milk, egg into batter. 2. Heat skillet medium 2 min. 3. Pour batter 1/4 cup per pancake. 4. Cook 2-3 min each side. 5. Serve with butter and syrup."

Title: Beef Tacos
How_To_Cook: "1. Cook beef medium 5-6 min. 2. Warm tortillas 1 min. 3. Dice lettuce, cheese. 4. Assemble tacos with beef, vegetables. 5. Add salsa, serve."

Title: Omelette with Ham and Cheese
How_To_Cook: "1. Beat eggs with milk. 2. Heat butter medium 1-2 min. 3. Pour eggs into pan 2 min. 4. Add ham, cheese, cook 3-4 min. 5. Fold omelette, serve hot."

Title: BBQ Chicken Pizza
How_To_Cook: "1. Preheat oven 425°F. 2. Roll dough. 3. Top with chicken, cheese, bbq sauce, onion. 4. Bake 12-15 min. 5. Slice and serve."

Title: Shrimp Scampi
How_To_Cook: "1. Boil spaghetti 8-10 min. 2. Sauté garlic in butter 2 min. 3. Add shrimp 4-5 min. 4. Toss with spaghetti. 5. Drizzle lemon juice, serve."

Title: Turkey Sandwich
How_To_Cook: "1. Toast bread 1-2 min. 2. Layer turkey, lettuce, tomato. 3. Spread mayonnaise. 4. Assemble sandwich. 5. Serve immediately."

Title: Beef Chili
How_To_Cook: "1. Sauté onion medium 3 min. 2. Add beef, cook 5-6 min. 3. Add beans, tomato, chili powder. 4. Simmer 20 min. 5. Serve hot."

Title: Pasta Carbonara
How_To_Cook: "1. Boil pasta 8-10 min. 2. Cook pancetta 3-4 min. 3. Beat egg with cream, parmesan. 4. Toss pasta with pancetta and egg mixture. 5. Serve immediately."

Title: Fish and Chips
How_To_Cook: "1. Preheat oil 350°F. 2. Slice potatoes, fry 5-6 min. 3. Coat fish with flour, fry 4-5 min. 4. Drain oil. 5. Serve hot with tartar sauce."

Title: Chicken Noodle Soup
How_To_Cook: "1. Boil chicken 15 min. 2. Add vegetables 5 min. 3. Add noodles, cook 8 min. 4. Season to taste. 5. Serve hot."

Title: Egg Salad Sandwich
How_To_Cook: "1. Boil eggs 10 min. 2. Mash eggs, mix with mayonnaise, mustard. 3. Toast bread 1-2 min. 4. Spread egg mixture. 5. Add lettuce, serve."

Title: Beef Burrito
How_To_Cook: "1. Cook beef 5-6 min. 2. Warm tortilla 1 min. 3. Add rice, beans, beef, cheese. 4. Roll tightly. 5. Serve immediately."

Title: Chicken Quesadilla
How_To_Cook: "1. Cook chicken 6 min. 2. Sauté onions, peppers 3 min. 3. Layer chicken, cheese, vegetables on tortilla. 4. Cook 3-4 min per side. 5. Serve hot."

Title: Lasagna
How_To_Cook: "1. Preheat oven 375°F. 2. Cook noodles 8-10 min. 3. Layer noodles, meat, sauce, cheese. 4. Repeat layers, top with mozzarella. 5. Bake 25 min, serve."

Title: Pork Fried Rice
How_To_Cook: "1. Cook rice 12 min. 2. Heat oil medium 2 min. 3. Stir fry pork 5 min. 4. Add peas, egg, rice, cook 3 min. 5. Stir in soy sauce, serve."

Title: Banana Pancakes
Measurement: 100g;1 egg;50ml milk;1 tsp butter;1 tsp honey
How_To_Cook: "1. Mash banana. 2. Mix with flour, egg, milk. 3. Heat butter 1 min. 4. Pour batter, cook 2-3 min per side. 5. Drizzle honey and serve."

Title: Avocado Smoothie Bowl
Measurement: 1 avocado;50g oats;100ml almond milk;50g berries;1 tsp chia seeds
How_To_Cook: "1. Blend avocado, almond milk. 2. Stir in oats. 3. Pour into bowl. 4. Top with berries and chia seeds. 5. Serve chilled."

Title: Strawberry Yogurt Parfait
Measurement: 150g yogurt;50g granola;50g strawberries;1 tsp honey;5g almonds
How_To_Cook: "1. Layer yogurt, granola, strawberries. 2. Drizzle honey. 3. Top with almonds. 4. Chill 5 min. 5. Serve."

Title: Blueberry Muffins
Measurement: 100g flour;50g sugar;50ml milk;1 egg;1 tsp baking powder
How_To_Cook: "1. Mix dry ingredients. 2. Add milk, egg. 3. Fold in blueberries. 4. Pour into muffin tins. 5. Bake 18-20 min at 180°C."

Title: Spinach and Feta Omelette
Measurement: 3 eggs;50g spinach;30g feta;1 tsp olive oil;1 tbsp milk
How_To_Cook: "1. Beat eggs with milk. 2. Heat olive oil 1 min. 3. Add spinach, cook 2 min. 4. Pour eggs, add feta, cook 3-4 min. 5. Fold omelette and serve."

Title: Peanut Butter Banana Toast
Measurement: 2 slices bread;1 tbsp peanut butter;1 banana;1 tsp honey;1 tsp chia seeds
How_To_Cook: "1. Toast bread 1-2 min. 2. Spread peanut butter. 3. Slice banana on top. 4. Drizzle honey. 5. Sprinkle chia seeds and serve."

Title: Breakfast Burrito
Measurement: 1 tortilla;2 eggs;50g black beans;30g cheese;1 tsp salsa
How_To_Cook: "1. Scramble eggs 2-3 min. 2. Warm tortilla 1 min. 3. Layer eggs, beans, cheese. 4. Add salsa. 5. Roll and serve."

Title: Cottage Cheese with Fruit
Measurement: 150g cottage cheese;50g pineapple;50g berries;1 tsp honey;5g walnuts
How_To_Cook: "1. Place cottage cheese in bowl. 2. Chop pineapple. 3. Mix fruit with cheese. 4. Drizzle honey. 5. Top with walnuts and serve."

Title: Apple Cinnamon Oatmeal
Measurement: 50g oats;1 apple;1 tsp cinnamon;100ml milk;1 tsp honey
How_To_Cook: "1. Cook oats with milk 5 min. 2. Chop apple and add 2 min. 3. Stir in cinnamon and honey. 4. Cook 1 min more. 5. Serve warm."

Title: Mango Smoothie
Measurement: 100g mango;100ml yogurt;50ml orange juice;1 tsp honey;5g flax seeds
How_To_Cook: "1. Blend all ingredients 1-2 min. 2. Pour into glass. 3. Sprinkle flax seeds. 4. Chill 5 min. 5. Serve."

Title: Strawberry Banana Smoothie
Measurement: 100g strawberries;1 banana;100ml milk;1 tsp honey;5g chia seeds
How_To_Cook: "1. Blend all ingredients 1-2 min. 2. Pour into glass. 3. Sprinkle chia seeds. 4. Serve chilled."

Title: Avocado Egg Toast
Measurement: 2 slices bread;1 avocado;2 eggs;1 tsp olive oil;1 tsp salt
How_To_Cook: "1. Toast bread 1-2 min. 2. Mash avocado on toast. 3. Fry eggs 3-4 min. 4. Place eggs on toast. 5. Drizzle olive oil and serve."

Title: Breakfast Quinoa Bowl
Measurement: 50g quinoa;100ml milk;50g berries;1 tsp honey;5g almonds
How_To_Cook: "1. Cook quinoa 10 min. 2. Pour milk, stir. 3. Add berries and honey. 4. Top with almonds. 5. Serve warm."

Title: Cinnamon French Toast
Measurement: 2 slices bread;1 egg;50ml milk;1 tsp cinnamon;1 tsp butter
How_To_Cook: "1. Beat egg with milk and cinnamon. 2. Dip bread 1-2 min. 3. Heat butter 1 min. 4. Cook bread 2-3 min per side. 5. Serve warm."

Title: Berry Chia Pudding
Measurement: 30g chia seeds;150ml almond milk;50g berries;1 tsp honey;1 tsp vanilla
How_To_Cook: "1. Mix chia seeds and almond milk 2 min. 2. Refrigerate 2 hr. 3. Stir and add berries, honey, vanilla. 4. Chill 10 min. 5. Serve."

Title: Pumpkin Spice Oatmeal
Measurement: 50g oats;100ml milk;30g pumpkin puree;1 tsp cinnamon;1 tsp maple syrup
How_To_Cook: "1. Cook oats with milk 5 min. 2. Add pumpkin, cook 2 min. 3. Stir in cinnamon and maple syrup. 4. Serve warm."

Title: Peach Greek Yogurt Bowl
Measurement: 150g yogurt;50g peaches;50g granola;1 tsp honey;5g almonds
How_To_Cook: "1. Layer yogurt and granola. 2. Add peach slices. 3. Drizzle honey. 4. Sprinkle almonds. 5. Serve chilled."

Title: Almond Butter Toast
Measurement: 2 slices bread;1 tbsp almond butter;1 banana;1 tsp chia seeds;1 tsp honey
How_To_Cook: "1. Toast bread 1-2 min. 2. Spread almond butter. 3. Slice banana on top. 4. Sprinkle chia seeds, drizzle honey. 5. Serve."

Title: Breakfast Parfait
Measurement: 150g yogurt;50g granola;50g berries;1 tsp honey;5g flax seeds
How_To_Cook: "1. Layer yogurt and granola. 2. Add berries. 3. Drizzle honey. 4. Sprinkle flax seeds. 5. Serve chilled."

Title: Muesli with Berries
Measurement: 50g muesli;100ml milk;50g berries;1 tsp honey;5g almonds
How_To_Cook: "1. Pour milk over muesli. 2. Add berries. 3. Drizzle honey. 4. Sprinkle almonds. 5. Serve."

Title: Trail Mix
Measurement: 30g almonds;30g cashews;30g raisins;10g pumpkin seeds;10g dark chocolate
How_To_Cook: "1. Mix all ingredients in a bowl. 2. Portion into snack bags. 3. Serve immediately or store."

Title: Apple Slices with Peanut Butter
Measurement: 1 apple;2 tbsp peanut butter;1 tsp honey;1 tsp chia seeds;
How_To_Cook: "1. Slice apple 5 mm thick. 2. Spread peanut butter on slices. 3. Drizzle honey. 4. Sprinkle chia seeds. 5. Serve immediately."

Title: Greek Yogurt with Honey and Walnuts
Measurement: 150g Greek yogurt;1 tsp honey;15g walnuts;5g cinnamon;
How_To_Cook: "1. Scoop yogurt into bowl. 2. Drizzle honey. 3. Add walnuts. 4. Sprinkle cinnamon. 5. Serve chilled."

Title: Carrot Sticks with Hummus
Measurement: 100g carrot sticks;50g hummus;1 tsp olive oil;1 tsp lemon juice;
How_To_Cook: "1. Wash and cut carrots into sticks. 2. Place hummus in a bowl. 3. Drizzle olive oil and lemon juice. 4. Dip carrot sticks. 5. Serve."

Title: Rice Cakes with Almond Butter
Measurement: 2 rice cakes;2 tbsp almond butter;1 tsp honey;
How_To_Cook: "1. Spread almond butter on rice cakes. 2. Drizzle honey. 3. Serve immediately."

Title: Banana Chips
Measurement: 1 banana;1 tsp coconut oil;1 tsp cinnamon;
How_To_Cook: "1. Slice banana thin. 2. Toss with coconut oil and cinnamon. 3. Bake at 150°C 20 min. 4. Cool and serve."

Title: Energy Balls
Measurement: 50g oats;30g peanut butter;20g honey;10g chocolate chips;5g chia seeds
Substitutions: almond butter, agave syrup, vegan chocolate
How_To_Cook: "1. Mix all ingredients 2 min. 2. Roll into 10 balls. 3. Chill 10 min. 4. Serve or store."

Title: Cheese and Crackers
Measurement: 30g cheddar;5 crackers;1 tsp olive oil;1 tsp herbs;
How_To_Cook: "1. Slice cheese. 2. Arrange on plate with crackers. 3. Drizzle olive oil. 4. Sprinkle herbs. 5. Serve."

Title: Cucumber Slices with Guacamole
How_To_Cook: "1. Slice cucumber 5mm thick. 2. Serve with guacamole. 3. Drizzle lime juice. 4. Serve chilled."

Title: Greek Yogurt with Berries
Measurement: 150g Greek yogurt;50g blueberries;50g strawberries;1 tsp honey;
How_To_Cook: "1. Layer yogurt with berries. 2. Drizzle honey. 3. Serve chilled."

Title: Nut and Seed Bars
Measurement: 30g almonds;30g sunflower seeds;20g honey;10g oats;5g dried cranberries
How_To_Cook: "1. Mix all ingredients 2 min. 2. Press into small tray. 3. Chill 20 min. 4. Cut into bars. 5. Serve."

Title: Roasted Chickpeas
Measurement: 100g chickpeas;1 tsp olive oil;1 tsp paprika;
How_To_Cook: "1. Preheat oven 180°C 5 min. 2. Toss chickpeas with oil and paprika. 3. Roast 20 min. 4. Cool and serve."

Title: Edamame
How_To_Cook: "1. Boil edamame 5 min. 2. Sprinkle salt. 3. Serve hot or cold."

Title: Celery with Peanut Butter
Measurement: 2 celery sticks;1 tbsp peanut butter;1 tsp honey;
How_To_Cook: "1. Spread peanut butter on celery sticks. 2. Drizzle honey. 3. Serve immediately."

Title: Mini Caprese Skewers
Measurement: 10 cherry tomatoes;10 small mozzarella balls;5 fresh basil leaves;1 tsp balsamic
How_To_Cook: ""1. Thread tomatoes mozzarella, basil onto skewers. 2. Drizzle balsamic. 3. Serve chilled.""

Title: Rice Pudding
Measurement: 50g rice;100ml milk;1 tsp sugar;1 tsp cinnamon;
How_To_Cook: "1. Cook rice with milk 10 min. 2. Stir in sugar and cinnamon 2 min. 3. Serve warm or chilled."

Title: Fruit Salad

How_To_Cook: "1. Chop fruits. 2. Mix in bowl. 3. Drizzle lemon juice. 4. Serve chilled."

Title: Oatmeal Cookies
How_To_Cook: "1. Mix ingredients 2 min. 2. Shape cookies. 3. Bake 12-15 min at 180°C. 4. Cool and serve."

Title: Banana Bread Muffins
Measurement: 100g flour;50g banana;50ml milk;1 egg;1 tsp baking powder
How_To_Cook: "1. Mash banana. 2. Mix with flour, milk, egg. 3. Pour into muffin tins. 4. Bake 18-20 min at 180°C. 5. Cool and serve."

Title: Chocolate Dipped Strawberries
Measurement: 10 strawberries;20g dark chocolate;1 tsp coconut oil;
How_To_Cook: "1. Melt chocolate with coconut oil 2 min. 2. Dip strawberries. 3. Chill 5 min. 4. Serve."
